City Online Services Ltd is currently undergoing a significant fundamental turnaround, evidenced by an extraordinary return on equity of 143.07% compared to the sector benchmark of 7.79% [E8]. This performance is supported by recent data showing that profit growth is now exceeding one-year price growth by 26%, signaling that the company is beginning to outperform market expectations [E36]. The business is clearly in a phase of accelerating earnings growth, which has triggered positive screens for year-over-year profit growth exceeding 20% [E44, E46]. While the stock trades at a negative book value, the current price of ₹ 7.73 relative to that book value suggests a unique valuation dynamic that warrants closer inspection [E1]. Conceded: the company has struggled with long-term sales contraction, as evidenced by compounded sales growth of -13% over five years and -12% over three years [E12, E13, E40]. Despite these historical top-line challenges, the recent shift toward positive sales growth of 2% over the trailing twelve months indicates a potential stabilization of the business model [E14].
